core_obligations: Show the four conditions are equivalent: radicals commute with inverse images, the implication to the prime condition is immediate, radical ideals are intersections of the primes above them, and the prime condition translates into surjectivity on spectra (proof lines 6056-6068).

Show the property survives base change by checking that a prime of the new base still lies in the image, which is tested by the nonvanishing of the tensor product with its residue field, and rewriting that tensor product as a further base change (proof lines 6070-6086).
proof_roadmap: Chain the four characterisations through radicals and membership in the image (proof lines 6056-6068).
Verify base change stability by a residue field computation (proof lines 6070-6086).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent conditions for surjectivity of the map on spectra of a ring map: the radical of an extended ideal contracts back, radical ideals contract back, primes do, and the map on spectra is onto, and it adds that the property is stable under base change (statement lines 6038-6054). The proof does not work with the topology on the spectra: it chains the algebra on radicals and inverse images, uses that radical ideals are intersections of primes, translates the prime condition into membership in the image, and then proves base change stability by a residue field computation (proof lines 6056-6086). The rewriting of the tensor product with a residue field is the step carrying the base change part. H2.
